verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is a SaaS app-building platform that could plausibly publish an API spec, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API or a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
